name: Oracle Object Storage Always Free
free_limit: OCI Always Free Object Storage: 20 GB combined Standard/Infrequent Access/Archive storage on Always Free-only accounts and 50,000 Object Storage API requests/month
watch_out: The 20 GB is shared across storage classes, not 20 GB per class. Accounts with paid/trial credits instead get 10 GB each in Standard, Infrequent Access and Archive plus 50,000 requests/month. Oracle warns objects exceeding the 20 GB Always Free-only limit may be deleted when the 30-day trial ends without upgrade. OCI account/payment verification and home-region restrictions apply.
